def factor_vol_spike_reversal(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    atr_pct = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]) / df_copy["close"].replace(0.0, np.nan)
    short_ema = atr_pct.ewm(span=5, min_periods=5).mean()
    long_mean = atr_pct.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    anomaly = (short_ema / long_mean.replace(0.0, np.nan)) - 1.0
    ret5 = df_copy["close"].pct_change(5)
    factor = -ret5 * anomaly
    df_copy["factor_vol_spike_reversal"] = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    return df_copy["factor_vol_spike_reversal"]
